provenance: Self-authored programs imported into a fresh disposable original G1 profile, then sequentially called only through EXPR source strings. Actual return values recorded; no physical hardware or vendor bytes.

programs.name: DYNA_MODULE
programs.source: LOCAL count:=100; EXPORT DYNA(x) BEGIN count:=count+x; PRINT(count); RETURN count; END;

programs.name: DYNB_MODULE
programs.source: LOCAL count:=10; EXPORT DYNB(x) BEGIN RETURN {EXPR("count:=count+x"),EXPR("DYNA(x)"),count}; END;

programs.name: DYNG_MODULE
programs.source: EXPORT DYNCOUNT:=7; EXPORT DYNG() BEGIN RETURN DYNCOUNT; END;

cases.name: first
cases.source: EXPORT DYNONE() BEGIN LOCAL n:=3; RETURN {EXPR("DYNA(n)"),EXPR("DYNA(n)")}; END;

cases.name: nested
cases.source: EXPORT DYNNEST() BEGIN LOCAL n:=4; RETURN {EXPR("EXPR(\"DYNB(n)\")"),EXPR("DYNA(n)")}; END;

cases.name: bad_syntax
cases.source: EXPORT DYNBAD() BEGIN LOCAL v; IFERR EXPR("DYNA(1)+("); THEN v:="syntax"; END; RETURN {v,EXPR("DYNA(0)")}; END;

cases.name: failed_run
cases.source: EXPORT DYNFAIL() BEGIN LOCAL v; IFERR EXPR("DYNA(2)+1/0"); THEN v:="runtime"; END; RETURN {v,EXPR("DYNA(0)")}; END;

cases.name: grammar0
cases.source: EXPORT GRAM0() BEGIN A:=0; LOCAL r; IFERR r:=EXPR("A:=1;A+2"); THEN r:="error"; END; RETURN {r,A}; END;

cases.name: grammar1
cases.source: EXPORT GRAM1() BEGIN A:=0; LOCAL r; IFERR r:=EXPR("LOCAL n:=3; n+1"); THEN r:="error"; END; RETURN {r,A}; END;

cases.name: grammar2
cases.source: EXPORT GRAM2() BEGIN A:=0; LOCAL r; IFERR r:=EXPR("BEGIN A:=4;A+1 END"); THEN r:="error"; END; RETURN {r,A}; END;

cases.name: grammar3
cases.source: EXPORT GRAM3() BEGIN A:=0; LOCAL r; IFERR r:=EXPR("IF 1 THEN A:=4; END; A"); THEN r:="error"; END; RETURN {r,A}; END;

cases.name: grammar4
cases.source: EXPORT GRAM4() BEGIN A:=0; LOCAL r; IFERR r:=EXPR("1; END; EXPORT EVIL() BEGIN RETURN 99; END; //"); THEN r:="error"; END; RETURN {r,A}; END;
